text:
Sara is viciosa. His pupila oscura

of incitantes promesas is venero…

Bebe as un tudesco, and fuma and jura

with el canalla argot of un marinero.


His placer is violento. Besa, muerde

and grita, and al final of la batalla,

muere his voice and until la vista pierde

and in nerviosos ataques se desmaya.


¡Oh, jilguero embriagado of joy,

nadie you vio llorar!… ¡Tan sólo un day

furtivo llanto se asomó a tus eyes


and your mirada se perdió in el sky,

viendo dos hilos of your sangre rojos

temblando in la blancura of un pañuelo!…

translation.title: Sara is viciosa. His pupila oscura
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
